Margarita slice didn't have as much flavor as the long lines would make you think.

themes.label: Fast line service
themes.text: Reviewers say lines are common but move quickly and slices are served almost instantly.
quotes: Don't let the lines discourage you, THE SERVICE IS QUICK.
The line moves quickly so despite the line it's not a long wait.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Most find slices cheap and good value, but a couple feel about $3 a slice is overpriced for what it is.
quotes: Fast, cheap and tasty food.
Tourist trap, overpriced and overrated.

themes.label: Staff and service attitude
themes.text: Some praise friendly, efficient staff, while others report rude cashiers, a change mistake, or no masks during the pandemic.
quotes: Theres usually a line but they are lightning fast and pretty friendly.
the service was horrible they all had a horrible attitude and threw change onto the counter and walked away

themes.label: Celebrity photos and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the small, no-frills room with celebrity photos and its history, though space inside is limited.
quotes: the place is small and is covered in pictures of Joe with everyone famous you could ever imagine
the place has a good vibe, great price and history.

themes.label: Waterfront and bridge views
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the views of the Brooklyn and Manhattan bridges, the river and the city skyline, especially from the pier end and rooftop.
quotes: Three bridge scene is unbeatable with a drink from the Heineken bar.
Best view of the city especially at sun down

themes.label: Concerts and events
themes.text: Many visitors came for rooftop concerts and events and found it a great venue, though some had complaints about sound and entry lines.
quotes: Great place for a concert. Must go to
Here for Ringo Starr anf his All Star Band, a great concert venue.

themes.label: Limited shops and food
themes.text: Several reviewers found few shops, restaurants or things to do, with the old mall gone and the development still unfinished.
quotes: Great venue. Lack of food options though.
I'm disappointed that the mall isn't even a mall anymore.

themes.label: Rooftop ice skating
themes.text: Visitors enjoyed the elevated ice skating rink in winter, calling it amazing and fun.
quotes: Rooftop ice skating was amazing!
So much fun and I absolutely love the ice skating rink!

themes.label: Staff, security and queues
themes.text: A few reviewers complained about poor service, long security lines and unenforced no-smoking rules, while one praised helpful staff and funny bartenders.
quotes: A 30 minute queue for security is unacceptable.
Great space and helpful staff! Had a blast here, can't wait to go back!

themes.label: Taco quality and taste
themes.text: Most reviewers call the tacos delicious and among the best in New York, with several praising their authentic Mexican flavor.
quotes: The best tacos I have ever eaten! Excellent value for money
Delicious tacos, for which we miss the tacos of Mexico here you will taste them as if you were in Mexico

themes.label: Fast service, moving line
themes.text: Reviewers say the service is quick and that the long lines move fast, though the place is busy.
quotes: Food was amazing, line looked long but moved super fast, great place!
Line out the door. They move fast! We had our food in no time.

themes.label: Pork and meat choices
themes.text: Pork and adobada are often named as favorites, but one reviewer finds the pork hit or miss and another prefers chicken and beef.
quotes: The pork is hit or miss. Sometimes salty, when not salty, it's real good
Recommend the pork the most.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call the tacos cheap or good value, but others find them pricey, say prices rose, or say portions are small.
quotes: The best tacos, and they are cheap too!
They raised the price. With this price doesn't worth it.

themes.label: Limited vegetarian options
themes.text: A few reviewers say vegetarian and seafood choices are missing or scarce, though one found a cactus taco for vegetarians.
quotes: Their vegetarian/seafood options are non-existent which I find really weird.
they dont have veggetarian nor pescetarian options (the cactus were sold out)

themes.label: Burger quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the burgers as delicious, some calling them among the best they have had, though a few find them dry, greasy or just average.
quotes: Of the best burgers I've tasted in my life.
Very dry burger with very little sauce; mediocre

themes.label: Crowding and limited seating
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly describe the place as packed, with hardly any seats, standing tables and competition for a table.
quotes: You have to stand and eat if you plan on eating there, which we did.
Always too crowded, a competition to get a table!

themes.label: Speed of service and lines
themes.text: Some reviewers report long waits and lines, while others say ordering and service were surprisingly quick even when busy.
quotes: The food there is good, but the wait is so long!
Surprisingly took only 3 minutes on line before we got to order.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as kind, helpful and patient, though one reviewer found their attitude appalling.
quotes: workers are always very kind
the attitude from the staff was appalling

themes.label: Pricing and value
themes.text: Some find prices high and burgers shrinking, while others call the food well priced.
quotes: the price has only gotten more and more expensive and the burgers have gotten smaller
Delicious burgers and well priced.

themes.label: Live music and venue
themes.text: Reviewers praise the live music, sound and concert setting, though a few criticise the layout, sound, loud volume or a late start.
quotes: Unquestionably the best venue in the city for general admission shows.
Big stage, big sound, love it here!

themes.label: Food and fried chicken
themes.text: The food, especially the fried chicken, is widely praised as excellent, with only occasional comments that it is pricey.
quotes: Great chicken! hands down for real!
The food was better than the bowling. Very slippery balls, but EXCELLENT FOOD!

themes.label: Long waits for bowling
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits for lanes, no reservations, and frustration over extra bowling charges after paying entry.
quotes: excessively long waits for bowling (plus they don't take reservations)
We waiting almost 2 hours to bowl then when it was time to bowl, they told us we had to pay $25

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many find drinks, food and bowling overpriced, while others call drinks and tickets cheap or fairly priced.
quotes: Drinks and food are super overpriced.
Always a great lineup and cheap tickets.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff and bar service, but some report rude treatment, poor management and too few bartenders.
quotes: good selection of beers and attentive staff.
they can be pretty rude to customers

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, fast, helpful staff, but a few describe rude, indifferent or unprofessional service and a slow bowl.
quotes: Friendly staff, great food. Worth it!
Never experienced a more unprofessional staff.

themes.label: Ramen quality and broth
themes.text: Many call it the best ramen they have had, singling out the chicken paitan broth, rich flavor and special noodles.
quotes: The best bowl of Ramen I've had and I've had a lot!
The best ramen I have ever had. Get the chicken fat special, it will blow your mind.

themes.label: Salty or heavy broth
themes.text: Several reviewers found the broth too salty, greasy or intensely animal-flavored, and some said it lacked depth.
quotes: the broth was too salty and greasy. The pork slices were too thick and fatty for my taste.
Very salty soup, but very good service.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find it overpriced compared with other ramen shops, while others call prices reasonable or good value.
quotes: Super expensive, decent ramen.
Reasonably priced ramen with a nice beer menu.

themes.label: Appetizers and sides
themes.text: Pork buns, fried chicken, cauliflower and pickles are repeatedly praised as excellent, sometimes alongside the ramen.
quotes: The pork steam buns are to die for (we would up getting another order because they were so delicious)
I highly suggest the Japanese Fried chicken before anything else, maybe even two orders

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and good service, though a few describe rude staff, slow service or being rushed.
quotes: Super good service and friendly staff. Come at 5:30pm and there is no line with lots of the seats available.
They rushed me with a check and the waiter was rude as hell.

themes.label: Food quality and variety
themes.text: Many find the hot pot and BBQ tasty, fresh and varied, but some report a limited selection, dry beef and tired vegetables.
quotes: Food is good and fresh with a variety of meats, seafood and vegetables.
Pretty small selection, beef is very dry, and cuts are quite thick.

themes.label: Birthday celebrations
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the free birthday meal and the costumed monkey or bear who sings and dances at the table.
quotes: Free hot pot on your birthday. Service is great.
Birthday monkey is so cute hehe :3

themes.label: Value and all-you-can-eat
themes.text: Reviewers see the all-you-can-eat format as good value, with cheap beers, though some say portions are excessive or staff skimp on BBQ.
quotes: Food is totally worth the money and there is a wide variety.
Good quality and worth the money.

themes.label: Space and atmosphere
themes.text: The place is described as spacious, clean and lively and good for groups, though the basement is noisy and one visit was empty.
quotes: Okay place, super noisy in the underground diner room. It's part of the hotpot feeling, but that was too much for us.
dining area was clean (there's a basement with additional seating!)

themes.label: Cheesecake
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the cheesecake excellent, often the main reason to visit, with red velvet, original and strawberry varieties singled out.
quotes: You have to try the cheesecake. It really is excellent
You can't leave NY without trying it

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe fast, friendly, attentive service and praise individual waiters, though one mentions a rude hostess and another a slow check.
quotes: Fast and friendly service even in high traffic.
Waiter was very good. Hostess needs social skills.

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Reviewers say dishes are big and generous, with some noting they ate too much or could share dishes.
quotes: large portions for a decent price
I think the hot dog is bigger then my son's arm.

themes.label: Food quality varies
themes.text: Many enjoyed breakfast, soups and sandwiches, while others found the food average, plain, below par or processed.
quotes: the sandwich (pastrami & corned beef) was below par.
Pastrami omelet was amazing

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices decent or accessible for the area, while others call the food pricey or expensive.
quotes: The prices are a bit high but it's expected for the location.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, professional service, but a few report slow, stretched, bored or unprofessional staff.
quotes: So impressed with the service quality. They really take good care of you and the food is always perfect.
The staff seemed bored and while they were attentive you got the feeling that they would prefer to be anywhere but at work.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food delicious, but some find it average or mediocre, or the meat tough.
quotes: Food is delicious ! Whatever u take !
The food is mediocre for what they charge.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many find it pricey, with some saying it is worth it and others calling it overpriced for what is served.
quotes: Yes, they are high priced, but given the location and the quality of the food, it makes sense.
Overpriced for what it was. Drinks overpriced and so were steak and desserts.

themes.label: Crowds and noise
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as packed, noisy and hard to get into, with long waits and tightly spaced tables.
quotes: the tables are glued to each other and there is a lot of noise.
Nice place but super crowded and hard to walk around the restaurant.

themes.label: Bakery, bread and pastries
themes.text: Reviewers single out the bread, croissants, sticky bun, coconut cake and other pastries as excellent.
quotes: Literally the best croissants I have had in America, and almost as good as you'll find in France.
Love love love the bakery! The sticky bun is sooo good!

themes.label: Smoked salmon and lox quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the lox and smoked fish as fresh, flavourful and among the best they have had.
quotes: This place has the freshest lox and most delicious cream cheese.
Lox is second to none, probably the best you can get in the whole country.

themes.label: Long waits and crowds
themes.text: Most reviewers say the line is long and crowded but worth it, while one reported a three-hour wait and several found it tiring.
quotes: The wait took three hours, only twenty customers placed orders.
Long wait, but def worth it! Wide selection,amazing begels.

themes.label: Friendly helpful staff
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the counter staff as friendly, attentive and helpful, including offering samples and recommendations.
quotes: the service is extremely helpful and attentive - they really take care of you.
Friendly staff easily helps to navigate through all the delicious dishes and are happy to give you samples.

themes.label: Bagel quality
themes.text: Most reviewers love the bagels, but one called theirs stale and small, and another said they are not great or large.
quotes: The bagels are made in house and they have the perfect chewy texture.
it was small, stale, and basically tasted like it was frozen and defrosted a few times

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some reviewers call it pricey or overpriced, while others say the cost is worth it or portions justify it.
quotes: Smoked salmon bagel with cream cheese was $11. WORTH EVERY PENNY!.
Their sandwiches are delicious and very generously portioned - you definitely get what you pay for.

themes.label: Cannoli quality
themes.text: Cannoli are repeatedly called the best, with one reviewer finding the shells pale and stale and the quality sub-standard.
quotes: The Best cannoli in New York
Best cannoli I've had in my life!

themes.label: Pastries and desserts
themes.text: Reviewers praise the variety and taste of the Italian pastries, cakes and desserts, calling them flaky, delicious and authentic.
quotes: Best Italian pastries ever (in America)
Pastries are so yummy and flaky.

themes.label: Gelato quality and price
themes.text: Some find the gelato delicious, while others call it tiny, overpriced, crumbly or bad for the money.
quotes: The Nutella gelato was delicious and we got to sit outside.
They charge 9.00 for a tiny scoop of bad gelato!!!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report rude servers, slow service and long waits at the counter.
quotes: the staff friendly and attentive but not overbearing
35 people waiting for baked goods.. 2 behind the counter.. We left

themes.label: Prices and tourist feel
themes.text: Several reviewers find prices high and call the place a tourist trap, though some accept the cost for the area.
quotes: I now feel that it is more of a tourist destination (trap?) than a must go.
Only wish it wasn't as expensive, though you can't expect anything cheaper for NYC.

themes.label: Variety of mac flavors
themes.text: Reviewers praise the wide range of mac and cheese varieties, sizes and build-your-own options, with buffalo chicken, cheeseburger and Napoletana singled out.
quotes: They've got about 12 styles or you have the option to customize and build your own.
They come in many varieties, sizes, and prices. You won't even know which one to choose.

themes.label: Waits and lines
themes.text: Several reviewers mention queues or waits at busy times, and advise going early or at off hours.
quotes: There's a bit of a wait but it's totally worth it. Come at an off hour to avoid the line.
Small place so go early to avoid lines and get seats.

themes.label: Vegan and gluten-free options
themes.text: Most reviewers enjoyed the vegan and gluten-free mac, though one found it tasted of coconut and another said it needed seasoning.
quotes: The vegan mac and cheese is delicious! Great mix in selection and cooked to perfection.
The vegan macaroni and cheese is good but tastes of coconut, which makes it mildly nauseating.

themes.label: Delivery and takeout problems
themes.text: Some reviewers had problems with delivery or takeout, including long delays, food that doesn't keep, and bags that let food spill.
quotes: The food is great, but I waited 2 hours for delivery. Not acceptable!
Food would be great if it wasn't upside down in the bag.

themes.label: Portion size and value
themes.text: Many find portions filling and prices reasonable, but a few say portions are small or the pan was not filled.
quotes: Portions are huge. The smallest size meant for a 'snack' will easily serve as lunch.
The size of a kids microwave dinner for 10 dollars

themes.label: Chicken and waffles
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the fried chicken and waffles the standout dish, with many naming it the best they have had, though a few found the chicken overcooked.
quotes: the best fried chicken I've had outside of New Orleans, paired with the best waffles outside of Belgium

themes.label: Long waits, small space
themes.text: Reviewers say the room is small, crowded and loud, with long waits especially at brunch and no reservations.
quotes: The place is small so there will be a wait, especially at brunch.
you may be elbow to elbow with other customers, especially if it's busy

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff and bartenders, but a few report horrible, distant or inconsistent service.
quotes: Very attentive waitress with a great personality.
Food is great; however the service is horrible.

themes.label: Prices and billing
themes.text: Some reviewers find prices high for what is served, and others report tipping confusion or being charged more than they wrote on the bill.
quotes: Things cost too much for what they are $4 for a can of soda and $17 for a cut waffle and 2 pieces of chicken
beware you MUST tip separately it's not included in the bill

themes.label: Drinks and music
themes.text: Reviewers praise the cocktails, bartenders and playlist, though one found the drinks small, weak and overpriced.
quotes: Phenomenal chicken and waffles. Great mixed drinks too.
Super-friendly bartenders, and the music selection was amazing!

themes.label: Cheesecake quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the cheesecake as delicious and the best they have had, though a few found it crumbled, sour, or only okay.
quotes: Mind blowing New York cheesecake. It's a must try!
the cheesecake was horrible. It was all crumbled up in pieces.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast, attentive service, but some report slow service, an unwelcoming staff member, or mistakes with orders.
quotes: The service is as good as it gets here and the food was delicious.
Even though it was empty service was pretty slow, and the waitress messed up the drinks.

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly mention generous, huge portions of food and desserts.
quotes: The portions are HUGE!! We had the steak burgers with Swiss. So good!
they always give generous portions and the food is really fresh.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or fair, while others call them high or not worth the quality of the meals.
quotes: The cheesecake is great...but the prices are kinda high.

themes.label: Savory food quality
themes.text: Opinions on non-dessert food vary: some praise burgers, sandwiches and onion rings, while others found meals average, cold, stale or spoiled.
quotes: Best onion rings I've ever come across.
Ordered pastrami bread was stale so disappointed.

themes.label: Pizza taste and crust
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the thin, crispy New York-style slice, its sauce and flavor, though a few call it mediocre, burned or heavy.
quotes: Simply great New York style pizza. Crispy thin crust, huge slice with great balance of ingredients.
Not greasy, nice and thin, and perfect. That tomato sauce is seriously like no other.

themes.label: Crowds, lines and seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe busy late-night crowds and lines that move fast, but the space is small with very few seats.
quotes: At night there is always a line, but it moves pretty fast.
I wish they had more seats. They only have like 3 seats.

themes.label: Customer service
themes.text: Many describe fast, friendly and helpful staff, while one reviewer found them rude and unhelpful and another complained about slow delivery.
quotes: Classic NYC-style slice, very quick service. Guys at the counter were on the ball, and good at their jobs.
They were not helpful at all and were even rude when we asked for help

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find the slices cheap and fair for the quality, while others call them overpriced or typical NYC pricing.
quotes: Really good pizza at a fair price.
Pizza isn't bad but not worth the price. Overrated and overpriced

themes.label: Late-night hours
themes.text: Reviewers value that it is open late and works well for a slice after a night out.
quotes: Great pizza open until late hours

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers praise the hidden pawn shop entrance, glamorous decor, music and lively vibe, though a few find it stale or too dim.
quotes: Great place hidden in a pawn shop. Great atmosphere, good food & cocktails
the ambiance of the room is great. It's dark and elegant, but not too stuffy.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and creative, naming small plates, tacos, scallops, tomato soup dumplings and donuts.
quotes: Fantastic brunch , tomato soup dumplings are a must !
Delicious and unique plates, amazing sear on the scallops

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Many find drinks and small plates expensive, with tapas-style portions leaving some unsatisfied, though a few say it is worth it for special occasions.
quotes: Sweet decor but super expensive drinks. 14 dollars for a Gin and tonic.
Expensive for little tidbits.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive service, but others report rude staff, security or managers, and slow or poorly handled seating.
quotes: our server handled the entire meal perfect. Great timing, very friendly, and anticipated our needs.
Staff were rude. Cocktails were awful. Just no.

themes.label: Cocktails and drinks
themes.text: Several reviewers single out the creative cocktail menu and good drinks, though a few complain of badly made or awful cocktails.
quotes: my fave is the creative sweet and savory drinks menu.
incredible craft cocktails and really delicious food

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, but others describe rude, slow or forgetful servers and long waits to be served.
quotes: Waiters and waitresses are really nice, quick and accurate.
Great food, but the service was awful. My waitress was rude & forgot something.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most call the food tasty, with praise for lobster and seafood dishes, but some found it cold, salty, tough or artificial-tasting.
quotes: Food was cold. A lame waiter, even by New York standards.
Yum! The lobster & steak!!! Highly recommended

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices good for seafood, while others say it is pricey or overpriced for what it is, especially given the Times Square location.
quotes: Best place and price to have seafood in New York city
But it's time square pricey and that's not great.

themes.label: Waiting time
themes.text: Several reviewers complain about slow queues, delayed orders or long waits, particularly for takeout, though one says their order came quickly.
quotes: Food is good but the wait time is unacceptable. Especially for take out.
The checkout process took almost 45 minutes.

themes.label: Location and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the Times Square location and describe the restaurant as comfortable, roomy and pleasant for couples and groups.
quotes: Structured on several floors, it offers large rooms where you can comfortably settle.
This is a very conveinant location. Great food!

themes.label: Staff friendliness and rudeness
themes.text: Many reviewers describe rude, unprofessional or unfriendly staff, though several others found employees friendly and service nice.
quotes: The staff is really rude. One of the cashiers literally yelled at me and almost cursed at me
It was good. The employees are friendly

themes.label: Speed and waiting time
themes.text: Some reviewers praise short waits and quick service, while others report long lines, slow service and a 30-minute wait.
quotes: Shortest waiting time I've had at a Wendy's between ordering and receiving my food.
Too much waiting and poor service.

themes.label: Cleanliness and smell
themes.text: Reviewers complain about dirty tables and seating areas, bad smells, and a restaurant that was not clean.
quotes: Dirty they have homeless all over and they don't clean tables
downstairst was dirty and smelly in the downstairs seating area.

themes.label: Order accuracy
themes.text: Several reviewers say orders were wrong, incomplete or had items left out, sometimes needing repeated trips back.
quotes: First we did not get the right order until the fifth time.
Items left out of order and had to go back for them

themes.label: Food quality and taste
themes.text: Many call the burgers, fries and shakes good or the best fast food, but others found burgers greasy, flavorless or bad-smelling.
quotes: Very fresh and moist burger love the cheese. Great cheesy fries and thick mikeshake.
The burger was not bad but very greasy compared to those in other fast food.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, friendly, fast servers, though a few describe slow, rude or poor service.
quotes: the food came out in a timely manner, and the servers were attentive
The service is great too as they serve fast. All the waitress are patient

themes.label: Value and price
themes.text: Many find the all-you-can-eat price affordable for the quantity and variety, though a few say it is not worth the cost.
quotes: Amazing quantity and variety of food for price, just one food quality notch below K-town options that cost 2x
not worth the money, especially if you come in a large group.

themes.label: Birthday deal
themes.text: Reviewers highlight the free or discounted birthday meal, which requires a cake, and see the place as good for celebrations.
quotes: The birthday discount is a great deal (free meal the day of, or within three days of your birthday if you bring a cake).
Birthday people eat for free.

themes.label: Hot pot and BBQ food
themes.text: Many call the hot pot and BBQ tasty with good variety, while others find the meat frozen, the ingredients not fresh or the BBQ poorly cooked.
quotes: Don't bother with the BBQ, except for the shrimp, the meats are practically steaming on the grill
Absolutely loved the meat choices for bbq especially the beef and seafood.

themes.label: Steam, smell and cleanliness

quotes: Floor is slippery from all the steam and just kinda feels like a big steam room.
The vents are not that well and the smoke and steam might be uncomfortable at time when cooking.

themes.label: Smoked fish and lox
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the smoked fish, lox, herring and salmon as the best they have had, with a few finding it only good.
quotes: the best smoked fish and herring ever.
They have the best lox in town. I love it on an eggs benny, on a cream cheese bagel

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Waits, especially at weekend brunch, are common; many say the food is worth it, while others say it is not.
quotes: This is a crowded popular cafe. But it's worth to wait.
it may not be worth a long wait as there are many other brunch spots nearby.

themes.label: Friendly service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe the staff and service as friendly, excellent or fabulous, though one felt ignored and another was rushed out.
quotes: Great food and stellar service.
we were pretty much ignored when we arrived, and our service was not warm or inviting.

themes.label: Old-school atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the old-fashioned, cozy, historic feel and decor of the room.
quotes: The restaurant has an amazing old-school vibe and good jazzy background music.
its decorated like an old-time shop.

themes.label: Bagels and price
themes.text: Some love the bagels, while others call them overrated, hard or salty, and several describe the prices as high.
quotes: Best bagel I have tried.
Bagel was almost hard like a rock and the smoked salmon didn't have much flavor.

themes.label: Variety of food vendors
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the wide choice of restaurants and cuisines under one roof, so groups can each pick something different.
quotes: Something to eat for everyone, even in the family each order in a different restaurant and everyone is at the same table
A large selection of foods under one roof.

themes.label: Rooftop and bridge views
themes.text: The rooftop terrace and views of the Brooklyn Bridge and Manhattan skyline are widely described as amazing, especially at night.
quotes: Not to be missed, though, is the roof view of downtown Manhattan and the Brooklyn and Manhattan bridges.
it is located in a place with a breathtaking view, especially in the evening.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or affordable, while others call the food expensive or overpriced.
quotes: Great food at an affordable price.
Good choices, great atmosphere, but heinously overpriced.

themes.label: Crowds and noise
themes.text: Reviewers say the market gets very busy, especially on weekends and evenings, and some find it cramped or loud.
quotes: The market does get very crowded on the weekends and evenings.
Music was waaaaay to loud.

themes.label: Slow disorganized service

quotes: Slow service and confused staff at multiple of the restaurants.
took over an hour to be delivered as the staff was somewhat disorganized

themes.label: Long waits for tables

quotes: Worth the wait.... best scramble eggs

themes.label: Pancakes
